english.note: Use this when you need to emphasize that the district is an official administrative division.
Choose this instead of the broader 地區 when the region is explicitly an official administrative subdivision.

examples.english: This district is an official administrative division in Hong Kong.
examples.traditional: 呢個行政區係香港嘅正式行政分區。

examples.english: This administrative region will raise taxes this year.
examples.traditional: 呢個行政區今年會加稅。
